title: image-src carrying BOTH id and url (XOR violation) on an e-image inside an e-div-block
_comment: WP-Q01 INVALID fixture (one-per-failure-mode, Detailed-Req #4; 12-error-taxonomy.md §3.1 IMAGE_SRC_XOR_VIOLATION). The nested e-image's image-src carries BOTH id AND url — image-src-prop-type.php:36-44 validates ($has_id xor $has_url), so this is a HARD R9/§3.2 violation. AUTHORITATIVE error SET from Validator::dry_run on Elementor 4.1.1 is BOTH codes: the structural R9 check emits IMAGE_SRC_XOR_VIOLATION (exact prop path) AND the Props_Parser ALSO rejects the malformed image-src and throws → ATOMIC_SETTINGS_INVALID (expect.errors is an order-independent SET, §3.2.d). prefilter.verdict:reject — the TS pre-filter decides R9 image-src XOR structurally (incl. inside an `image` wrapper), so it rejects; the F06 loader therefore SKIPS the authoring-schema check (reject fixtures, fixture-loader.ts:206-230), which is needed because the both-id-and-url image-src is deliberately schema-malformed. meta-invariant reject⇒valid:false holds.
